_about: C §6 row 8: per-surface REGRESSION BOUNDS for .build/soak.py, judged on the quiet phase (seconds, whole response). Set 2 Oct 2026 from the seventh soak (dev database, Pi, SD card): p50 = 1.5 x measured, p95 = 2 x measured, each rounded up to a step of 0.25/0.3/0.5/0.75/1/1.25/1.5/2/2.5/3/3.5/4/4.5/5/6/7/8/9/10/12/15/20/25/30, and p95 capped at the soak's 30 s timeout. They bound regression, not acceptability: three surfaces are slow and have issues of their own. null = measured, not asserted. The four nulls are surfaces the seventh soak asked for on a part-full period, now pinned to full ones; set them from the next soak.
